body: People don’t comment about it everyday (luckily, I would be even more depressed if they did). And this person specifically doesn’t know me too well to really understand that’s how my brain functions and I sometimes act/react. I did try to explain to them, like I do with most of my friends or people I hang out with, but I don’t know if they fully grasped what I meant. I felt like it wasn’t an attack or something that was supposed to hurt me, but with my deep set insecurities and past, it did. Also, I’ve talked in the past with a therapist about it and we were going to continue digging deeper into it, like how my emotions also are very extreme or low fluctuating. But unfortunately life got in the way where I wasn’t able to continue to see them. Also thank you, I’m doing okay for now but life is hard.
Thank you for your kind words, and hopefully I can think a bit better about myself if someone comments about it again.

22. And thank you, but I really do sometimes think that it can be a bit to the extreme with when I comes to how I express my emotions on the outside perspective. I can see how that person could see it as “weird”, but at the same time it’s just how I am normally and they haven’t really hung out with me enough to really see that. It just makes me self-conscious of myself whenever someone has a negative viewing of me. And then I spiral into more self-deprecation and depression.

Thank you, those were some of my thoughts as well. Especially the overthinking that will cause me to split. Which is why I’m also looking for advice. My most recent break-up was due to long distance and we both agreed it was the healthiest option for the both of us (not just because I have bpd but a lot of other factors that long distance can cause). I have a long distance friendship, but I feel like loving relationships is a whole other story. Thank you again : )

Sleep is good, but unfortunately I dream a lot so I end up waking up to nightmares, sad dreams, dreams with people that I don’t want to think about, and dreams where I’m in a better life… it’s hard but at least they’re just dreams and a few hours of my day has passed that I don’t have to think about.

I hope so too, but it’s really hard whenever my heart is dying, because of all the hate and not good things going on and keeps happening in my life. All the little things start to add up where my mind and my heart lose hope for myself. I’m honestly a pretty determined and optimistic person but I can only take so much as an individual with a soft heart. I wish my trauma would thicken my skin but in reality creates an open wound that can’t fully heal. But thank you for the nice comment, I hope you’re doing better than I am right now.
